The desk runs in the browser. Models produce signals across 10 assets, the broker partner holds funds, and the platform charges no fee of its own - spreads and overnight charges still apply.
Our method is a desk review: no funded account, no trades. We read the published material in full, including unfilled placeholders and contradictions, and scored five fixed dimensions.
whatItClaims: 10 crypto assets through broker partners.
A free demo account with practice funds.
Around-the-clock support through the partner desk.
Signals generated without manual chart reading.
A US$200 minimum deposit to start.
whatWeChecked: The fee framing: no platform fees, but spreads embedded in every trade.
The support story: around-the-clock coverage claimed, exact figures conflicting.
The geo-restrictions: two lists on the page that do not agree.
The template marks: unfilled placeholders left in the wording.
The performance story: no verified track record behind the return claims.
The number reuse: one score figure doing more than one job.

steps.title: Register
steps.text: Open the signup page, enter your information and confirm the account by email.

steps.title: Fund
steps.text: Deposit the US$200 minimum by bank card, bank transfer, PayPal or Skrill.

steps.title: Configure
steps.text: Set your preferences, select automatic or manual execution, and run the practice account first.

pros: Free registration and a demo account.
redFlags: Template placeholders left unrendered.
Return claims without verification.
The fee that is not a fee: spreads embedded in every trade.

faqs.q: What happens after I sign up?
faqs.a: You confirm the account by email, fund US$200, set your risk preferences and choose automatic or manual mode. The demo account runs alongside while you learn.

faqs.q: Which assets can I trade?
faqs.a: 10 crypto assets through broker partners, per the published pages. The list varies between sections, so check the dashboard after signup.

faqs.q: How much support does it offer?
faqs.a: Unclear - around-the-clock coverage is claimed, while other sections quote different figures. Ask support to reconcile them before you fund anything.

faqs.q: Is it really fee-free?
faqs.a: The platform fee is absent, but every trade carries a broker spread the page itself calls the real cost. The headline says free; the fine print says otherwise. Budget for the fine print.

faqs.q: Can I trade manually?
faqs.a: Yes - the platform offers automatic and manual modes, so you can follow the signals or confirm each entry yourself.

bottomLine: As a product, Allied Stocks offers the expected setup and nothing that breaks. The issues sit in the published claims, and the claims are avoidable if you trade the minimum.
The final score lands at 4.5 - a capable platform held back by its own paperwork. Start small, verify the claims yourself and never trade money you cannot lose.
